veh:jeep-renegade-2015-latitude.notes: 2.4L Tigershark MultiAir2 (sales code ED6/ED8/EDD/EDE range). In scope for Customer Satisfaction Notification W80 (oil consumption inspection) IF this vehicle is FWD — the primary-source W80 document covers 2015-2018 Renegade FWD only, not AWD; drivetrain is not recorded on this profile, so confirm from the door-jamb sticker or VIN before relying on W80. NOT in scope for W84 (PCM reprogramming) — verified against the primary source, W84 covers only 2017 Renegade AWD (plus 2014 Cherokee, 2017 Compass/Cherokee/Chrysler 200), not this 2015 model year. See known-campaigns.json. Reference adapter: OBDLink MX+ with a gray-type OBD-II adapter/extension between the vehicle DLC and the MX+ for better physical port access and for AlfaOBD Proxi alignment when prompted (does not change ISO 15765-4 by itself). Proxi / module sync: Functions → proc:fca-proxi-alignment. See docs/OPERATOR_OBD_MANUAL.md.

veh:silverado-2500hd-2003.notes: VIN-confirmed via NHTSA vPIC decode (2026-09-26): LQ4 Iron 6.0L V8 (Vortec 6000, not LQ9/L18/other 6.0 variant), 4WD/4x4, GVWR Class 2H (9,001-10,000 lb), extended-cab pickup body, assembled at GM's Pontiac, MI truck plant. Marketing trim (LS/LT/Work Truck) is not decodable from this VIN — leave unknown rather than guessing. Transmission type (automatic vs. manual) is also not decodable from the VIN and matters for at least one open recall — see known-campaigns.json (05V161000). OBD protocol is typically ELM327 auto-detect on this era (often SAE J1850 VPW on GMT800 — do not hard-force CAN; confirm from a live session). Shares SAE-generic cartridges. OEM depth in gm-vortec-6.0-stub re-frames knock-sensor and lean-fuel classes from corroborated TSBs 02-06-04-023A (1999-2002, P0332 only; this profile is 2003) and 05-06-04-029A (L59 rough idle/P0300; LQ4 VIN U is may-apply; retrieved text does not name lean codes or a coolant leak); no GM-only DL class yet. Field manual: docs/silverado-2500hd-field-manual.html. Do not invent GM-enhanced fault classes. A 2026-09-26 whole-truck research draft modeled this truck as an 8.1L L18 and left bearing, rod, and head torque, oil-filter torque, coolant-cap pressure, fan-clutch engagement temperature, starter draw, fuse amperages, transmission capacity, oil pressure, and cam offset unspecified. Those stay unspecified. Do not overwrite this LQ4 with that draft.
